claims: McDonald's Demon Sauce is a mustard-based dipping sauce.
McDonald's Demon Sauce is bright purple.
McDonald's Demon Sauce was launched on March 31, 2026.
McDonald's Demon Sauce was launched as part of the "KPop Demon Hunters" meal.
McDonald's Demon Sauce comes in the HUNTR/X 10-piece McNugget meal.
The HUNTR/X 10-piece McNugget meal includes "Hunter Sauce".
Demon Sauce is a "hot mustard" sauce.
Demon Sauce is described as having significant heat, tang, and a creamy Cajun-like spice kick.
Demon Sauce is strikingly vibrant purple.
Demon Sauce is featured specifically with the HUNTR/X meal.
The HUNTR/X meal contains 130 calories per serving.
Demon Sauce is part of a limited-time promotion aimed at adults.
"Hunter Sauce" is a separate, milder sweet chili sauce.
